title: 第202章 再临异端审判庭第201章 异端审判局与蒂娅
slug: 兼职管理女子监狱的异端审判官
content_zh:
第202章再临异端审判庭
狄曼列看向维罗娜，指了指身旁的女性：“这位是蒂娅姐”
“啊，你好”，维罗娜赶忙弯腰礼貌的开口
“你好呀，小维罗娜”，蒂娅继续靠着狄曼列微笑道：“我看过你的资料哦，真厉害，能看到摩菲”
“诶？”，维罗娜愣了一下，接着有些不好意思的挠了挠头：“我也不知道这算不算厉害了”
“呵呵”，蒂娅看向狄曼列：“摩菲在吗？”
“不在”，狄曼列摇了摇头
“好吧”，蒂娅摸了摸狄曼列的脸：“要我和你一起去吗？”
“不用了，蒂娅姐你睡觉吧”，狄曼列笑着说到：“我也不是去找事的”
“好，别太辛苦哦”
蒂娅微微笑了笑：“晚安”
说完，她松开狄曼列，整个人直接倒了下去
“啪”的一声，蒂娅躺在地上，眼睛迅速闭上，细微的呼吸也随之响起
见到这一幕，维罗娜被吓了一跳，有些手足无措的站在原地
“别在意，我们都习惯了”，狄曼列淡定的操作着光幕面板：“蒂娅姐大部分时候都在睡觉”
“直接睡在这里吗？”，维罗娜呆呆的看着进入酣梦的高挑女性
“嗯，没事的，等会儿就不见了”，狄曼列微微让身：“来，输入一下自己的魔力”
“好的”
维罗娜按照狄曼列的指示，将魔力释放进了某个设备，很快一道道资料划过，最终定格在了维罗娜的两张影像上
一张是维罗娜人类形态的样子，一张则是维罗娜巨龙形态的头颅

狄曼列看向维罗娜：“来，选一个，作为你以后资料的照片”
“唔.......”，维罗娜犹豫了一下：“典狱长大人您更喜欢哪个？”
“都喜欢”，狄曼列笑了笑：“随便选吧，反正可以换”
“嗯”，维罗娜点了点头，接着选择了自己人类形态的影像：“那就这个”
瞬间，所有资料被统合，最终化为一道微不可查的数据流进系统中
“好了，空间入口已经记录你的魔力了，等我教你改变空间频率之后你就可以自己进来了”，狄曼列迈开步伐：“走，去异端审判庭吧”
“好”，维罗娜跟在狄曼列身边，有些忐忑的问道：“典狱长大人，那个审判庭.......会问我些什么吗？”
和维罗娜进行身体交流的夜晚，狄曼列还是告诉了维罗娜不少事情，其中就包括需要由异端审判局裁决这件事
“大部分会问我，问到你的话正常回答就行”，狄曼列揉了揉维罗娜的头发：“别紧张，有事我会骂他们的”
“是”，维罗娜稍微安心了一点，轻声开口：“异端审判庭，是异端审判局的一个部门吗？”
“算是，但确切的说应该是异端审判局的核心，决定了秩序的走向”，狄曼列点了点头：“一些重大的决策，以及一些具有争议的任务和审判，都会由异端审判庭裁决。不同级别的事件会参与的审判庭成员级别与数量也不同”
content_en:
Chapter 202 Return to the Heretic Tribunal
Diamanlie looked at Verona and pointed at the woman next to him: "This is Sister Tia."
"Ah, hello", Verona hurriedly bent down and said politely
"Hello, little Verona", Tia continued to lean on Dimanlie and smiled: "I have seen your information, it is really amazing, you can see Murphy"
"Eh?" Verona was stunned for a moment, then scratched her head in embarrassment: "I don't know if this is awesome."
"Haha", Tia looked at Diamanlie: "Is Murphy here?"
"Not here." Diamanlie shook his head.
"Okay", Tia touched Dimanlie's face: "Do you want me to go with you?"
"No need, sister Tia, you can go to sleep," Diamanlie said with a smile, "I'm not looking for trouble."
"Okay, don't work too hard"
Tia smiled slightly: "Good night"
After saying that, she let go of Dimanlie and fell down.
With a "pop" sound, Tia lay on the ground, her eyes closed quickly, and her subtle breathing also sounded.
Seeing this scene, Verona was shocked and stood there at a loss.
"Don't worry, we are all used to it." Dimanlie calmly operated the light screen panel: "Sister Tia sleeps most of the time."
"Sleep here directly?" Verona stared blankly at the tall woman who fell into a deep sleep.
"Well, it's okay. I'll be gone in a moment." Diamanlie stepped aside slightly: "Here, let's input your magic power."
"Okay"
Verona followed Dimanlie's instructions and released the magic power into a certain device. Soon, data passed through one after another, and finally settled on two images of Verona.
One is Verona's human form, and the other is Verona's head in dragon form.
Diamanlie looked at Verona: "Here, choose one to use as a photo for your future information."
"Well..." Verona hesitated: "Which one do you prefer, Lord Warden?"
"I like them all," Diamanlie smiled: "Just choose whatever you want, you can change it anyway."
"Yeah", Verona nodded, and then chose the image of her human form: "Then this one"
In an instant, all the data was integrated and finally turned into an undetectable data stream into the system.
"Okay, your magic power has been recorded at the space entrance. After I teach you how to change the space frequency, you can come in by yourself." Dimanlie took a step forward: "Let's go to the Heretic Tribunal."
"Okay", Verona followed Diamanlie and asked with some anxiety: "Master Warden, will the Inquisition...will ask me anything?"
On the night of physical communication with Verona, Diamanlie still told Verona many things, including the need for the Inquisition to rule on the matter.
"Most of them will ask me. If I ask you, just answer normally." Diamanlie rubbed Verona's hair: "Don't be nervous, I will scold them if something happens."
"Yes", Verona felt a little relieved and said softly: "Is the Heretic Tribunal a department of the Heretic Tribunal?"
"Yes, but to be precise, it should be the core of the Heretic Tribunal, which determines the direction of the order." Dimanlie nodded: "Some major decisions, as well as some controversial tasks and trials, will be decided by the Heretic Tribunal. Different levels of events will involve different levels and numbers of Tribunal members."
